pages.title: Whiteout Transfer
pages.text: $(bold)RECORDED AUDIO TRANSCRIPT$()$(br)Recovered from an evac vehicle.$(br)Permission: not required$(br2)VOICE 1: Terminal directive says camp transfer. No pickup, no escort, just coordinates and a warning banner.$(br2)VOICE 2: Leon said ORSA wanted the station data more than the people in it.$(br2)VOICE 3: If that's true, why are we going to their camp at all?

pages.title: End Of Recording
pages.text: VOICE 1: Because staying there meant freezing in place.$(br2)VOICE 2: And this is different?$(br2)VOICE 3: Stop. Kill the lights. I can't see the road, I can't see the camp, and nobody is answering.$(br2)The last seconds are wind, a stalled engine, and someone saying the camp never sent anyone.
